description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 29.11.2021 to 05.12.2021
categorisation: This gazette content is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) that establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
